description.value: Chance Café is an independent neighbourhood café on Commercial Street in Vancouver's Commercial Drive area, serving organic and fairtrade coffee alongside a signature International Fog Series and DIY bubble tea kits you can customize and take home. The café offers online ordering with in-store pickup and local delivery across Greater Vancouver through Square. Gift cards are available, and the menu leans into specialty beverage culture with a community-minded feel.
